title: Closing a Tire Set as Worn Out or Retired — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
An active Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set closes when no warranted tire of it remains in service. The set must be in status active when it is closed.

- **Worn out.** It closes as worn out on the date its last position is adjusted for treadwear, once every one of its tire-count positions carries an adjustment.
- **Retired.** It closes as retired on the date Crestline records that the vehicle was sold or the tires were taken off for any reason other than adjustment, or on the date an inspection shows the warranty term or the effective warranted miles have run out. Because the warranty is not transferable on any line, a sold vehicle's set is retired and never transferred to the buyer.
- **Effect.** Closing the set ends its warranty and its rotation pricing, but an adjustment credit still within its validity period remains usable.

**Cases (hypothetical sets):** a 4-tire set with adjustments on all 4 positions closes as worn out on the date of the fourth; a set whose vehicle was sold closes as retired on the date the sale is recorded.
